subject: Customer kickoff — proposed windows, attendees, and links
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Moreno <lisa.moreno@arborbio.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer kickoff — proposed windows, attendees, and links

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We're excited to get Arbor Bio live. I pulled together a short kickoff brief (attached) and a couple of proposed windows to get the project team together:

- Option A: Tue, Jun 24 — 10:00–11:00 PT (engineering + product)
- Option B: Wed, Jun 25 — 14:00–15:00 PT (product + ops)

Goal for the session: align stakeholders, confirm roles & responsibilities, run through the tentative implementation timeline, and verify a short tech-check for SSO/integration access.

Please confirm: (1) preferred window, (2) final attendee list (names + roles), and (3) any scheduling constraints we should avoid. Also flag whether you need Redwood to host the Zoom link or if Arbor will provide.

Attachments: kickoff_brief_v1.pdf (1 page) — includes draft agenda, prerequisites, and a short Milestone timeline.

If those two windows don't work, propose two alternatives and we'll find a match. Once we lock a time I'll send the calendar invite, the meeting link, and a short pre-kick checklist for your engineers.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
p: +1 415-555-0192
From: Lisa Moreno <lisa.moreno@arborbio.com>

Subject: Re: Customer kickoff — proposed windows, attendees, and links

On Thu, Jun 19, 2025 at 9:12 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:

> 
> Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We're excited to get Arbor Bio live. I pulled together a short kickoff brief (attached) and a couple of proposed windows to get the project team together:

> 
> Goal for the session: align stakeholders, confirm roles & responsibilities, run through the tentative implementation timeline, and verify a short tech-check for SSO/integration access.

Thanks Naomi — both windows work for us, leaning slightly toward Option B because our product lead is on travel the morning of the 24th. Confirmed attendees from Arbor:

- Lisa Moreno — Head of Product (owner)
- Samir Patel — Platform Engineer (SSO & infra)
- Michael Ruiz — Security (audits & compliance)
- Delivery list: delivery@arborbio.com (ops alias)

Two asks from our side before the kickoff:
1) Can we get a 20–30 minute tech dry-run for SSO (just Samir + Naomi/Redwood engineer) — ideally 30 minutes before the session?
2) Please include a short slide on audit/logging retention and how Redwood surfaces those logs.

If you can send the Drive link with the agenda I’ll drop Michael into the invite and confirm the ops alias.

Appreciate it —
Lisa
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Quick follow from the CS/Eng side — thanks Lisa for confirming attendees.

We will:
- Lock Option B (Wed, Jun 25 — 14:00–15:00 PT).
- Run a 30-minute tech dry-run at 13:30 PT (Samir + Naomi + one Redwood engineer).
- Attach attendee roster and a working agenda snapshot for the call.

Planned agenda (30–45m):
1) Welcome & outcomes (Naomi, 5m)
2) Introductions & ownership (Arbor + Redwood, 5m)
3) High-level implementation timeline and milestones (Monica, 7m)
4) Security & logging overview (Ben, 8m — include retention table + audit endpoints)
5) Integration & SSO dry-run notes (Samir + Redwood eng, 8m)
6) Next steps & action owners (Naomi, 2–5m)

Meeting logistics:
- Zoom (Redwood host): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode: RBxKick1)
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bKickoffDoc (agenda + milestone tracker)
- HubSpot: HS-Record-74219 (linked to account)

Attachments: attendee_roster_arbor_20250620.csv

Ben — I’ll add the short logging/retention slide to the Drive. Priyom — can you confirm which Redwood engineer will join the dry-run?

Naomi — once you confirm we'll send the calendar invite with the meeting link and a 30-minute pre-call dry-run invite.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks everyone. Confirming calendar invite: Wed, Jun 25, 2025 14:00–15:00 PT (Zoom hosted by Redwood).

I will include:
- Calendar invite to all confirmed attendees including Michael Ruiz (security) and delivery@arborbio.com.
- 13:30–14:00 PT dry-run invite (Samir + Naomi + Redwood eng).
- Attach the short pre-kick checklist (SSO test steps + required access) and the attendee roster.

Pre-kick checklist highlights:
- Verify SSO SAML metadata uploaded to Redwood console (Samir)
- Confirm service account keys for integration (if applicable)
- Ensure Michael has view access to audit/logging slide in Drive

Action items:
- Priyom: assign Redwood engineer for the dry-run and confirm by EOD today.
- Ben: upload logging retention slide to Drive (done by 11:00 PT tomorrow).
- Lisa: confirm Michael's calendar address and whether ops alias should be on the primary invite or as a calendar-only attendee.

If there are no changes I’ll send the invites in the next hour so calendars can be updated. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
